title: Add Customer Delivery Details Form Before Razorpay Payment

requirements.summary: Insert a Customer Delivery Details form step between product/cart selection and Razorpay payment initiation, collecting Full Name, Delivery Address, and Phone Number with validation before allowing payment to proceed
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Buy Now' on the product detail page shows the delivery details form before opening Razorpay
Proceeding through the Cart/Checkout page shows the delivery details form before opening Razorpay
Form has labeled input fields for Full Name, Delivery Address, and Phone Number
Submitting with any empty field shows a validation error and blocks payment
Razorpay checkout is only initiated after valid form submission
Collected name, address, and phone number are passed along with the order creation call

file_operations.description: Create a modal dialog component that collects customer delivery details (Full Name, Delivery Address as textarea, Phone Number) with validation ensuring all three fields are non-empty. Include a submit button that triggers the onSubmit callback with the collected DeliveryInfo data. Use shadcn/ui Dialog, Input, Textarea, Label, and Button components for consistent styling.

Integrate DeliveryDetailsModal into the Buy Now flow. When 'Buy Now' is clicked, open the delivery details modal first. On modal submission with valid data, store the DeliveryInfo and then trigger the existing Razorpay checkout with the collected delivery information included in the order creation payload. Update the useRazorpay hook call to pass guestDeliveryInfo containing the collected name, address, and phone number.

Integrate DeliveryDetailsModal into the Cart checkout flow. Replace or precede the existing checkout button action with a flow that opens the delivery details modal. On modal submission with valid data, store the DeliveryInfo and then proceed with Razorpay payment, passing the collected delivery information (fullName, address, phoneNumber) in the guestDeliveryInfo field of the OrderInput when creating the order.

Update the useRazorpay hook to accept an optional guestDeliveryInfo parameter of type DeliveryInfo. Modify the createOrder call to include this guestDeliveryInfo in the OrderInput payload when present. Ensure backward compatibility by making the parameter optional with a default empty or null value.

requirements.summary: Display customer delivery information (Full Name, Delivery Address, Phone Number) in the Admin Orders panel, both in order list cards and in the OrderDetailModal
acceptanceCriteria: AdminOrders page shows customer name and phone number on each order card
OrderDetailModal displays Full Name, Delivery Address, and Phone Number in a clearly labeled section
Fields are visible for all new orders containing delivery details
If an older order has no delivery details, the fields display a fallback such as 'Not provided'

file_operations.description: Update each order card in the AdminOrders list to display the customer's full name and phone number from order.guestDeliveryInfo. Add these fields below or alongside existing order details (order ID, total, status). If guestDeliveryInfo is missing or fields are empty, display 'Not provided' as a fallback.

Add a 'Delivery Information' section to the OrderDetailModal that displays Full Name, Delivery Address (with line breaks preserved), and Phone Number from order.guestDeliveryInfo. Use clear labels and formatting. If guestDeliveryInfo is missing or any field is empty, display 'Not provided' for that field. Place this section prominently near the top of the modal after customer principal or before order items.
